en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a symmetrical country manor house with a tiled roof and central balcony. In front of the entrance stands a pedestal with an armillary sphere surrounded by a circular flower bed and gravel courtyard. Trees frame the building on both sides. White caption text is printed at the lower left and a publisher/photographer credit at the lower right.
